description: Convert one file to another format (one file in, one file out). Input – exactly one of: "url" (a public http(s) link), "text" + "filename" (source as text, e.g. Markdown, HTML, CSV, SVG; max 1 MB), "data_base64" + "filename" (a small binary file). For a file on the user's computer use create_upload (an upload page for the user, or curl if you can run commands). The source format comes from the extension of filename or of the URL path; pass "from" when there is none. For archiving or authorities use "to": "pdfa" (PDF/A-2b, scans get a text layer by OCR; the file is a .pdf and the done job carries "validation" – the result of an independent conformance check). There are no conversion options (quality, resolution, page range…) – defaults are used. A multi-page document converted to an image format gives the first page only (use "cbz" for all pages as images in a ZIP). To SEE a result you cannot read (PDF, DOCX, PPTX…), call convert again with its download_url as "url", "to": "png" and "return": "content" – you get an image of the first page. Returns the job: "done" with download_url (served by our conversion server hosting2.synetix.cz, valid until expires_at, 14 days), "waiting" (call get_job) or "error". Errors come back with isError and a code: invalid_arguments (fix the call), limit_reached (see get_account; wait, do not retry in a loop), file_too_large, unsupported_format (unknown source – pass "from" if the name has no extension), unsupported_target (call list_formats with "from"), download_failed (the URL is not publicly reachable), busy (too many downloads from URLs at once – retry in a few seconds), node_unavailable (retry later), not_found.

data_base64.description: Small binary source file as base64 – only for files of tens of kB (the whole base64 text goes through your output; hard limit 2 MB). For larger files use create_upload or a URL.

from.description: Source format id, only when it cannot be told from the file name extension – e.g. a URL like download.php?id=5. Otherwise leave it out.

return.description: "link" (default): status and download_url only. "content": when the job is done, also return the result inline – text formats (txt, md, csv, json, xml, srt…) up to 100 kB (longer text is cut), HTML as the inner <body> only, images (png, jpg, gif, webp) up to 1 MB; other formats always come back as a link. Use "content" when you need to read or show the result yourself.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the source file.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the conversion to finish (0–25). If it is still running afterwards, the status is "waiting" – call get_job with the id.

name: convert
title: Convert a file
